title: Sonder SAT: 1000 Most Common SAT Words
description: A bilingual English-Vietnamese collection adapted for Sonder SAT from the supplied 1000 Most Common SAT Words list, with concise definitions and contextual examples.

terms.translation: làm nhục, hạ thấp phẩm giá
terms.exampleSentence: After being overthrown and abased, the deposed leader offered to bow down to his conqueror.

terms.translation: giảm bớt, làm yếu đi
terms.exampleSentence: The rain poured down for a while, then abated.

terms.meaning: (v.) to give up a position, usually one of leadership
terms.translation: thoái vị, từ bỏ chức vụ (thường là lãnh đạo)
terms.exampleSentence: When he realized that the revolutionaries would surely win, the king abdicated his throne.

terms.translation: bắt cóc, cưỡng đoạt
terms.exampleSentence: The evildoers abducted the fairy princess from her happy home.

terms.meaning: (n.) something that differs from the norm
terms.translation: sự sai lệch, khác thường
terms.exampleSentence: In 1918, the Boston Red Sox won the World Series, but the success turned out to be an aberration, and the Red Sox have not won a World Series since.

terms.translation: tiếp tay, giúp sức, khuyến khích
terms.exampleSentence: The spy succeeded only because he had a friend on the inside to abet him.

terms.translation: ghét cay ghét đắng, căm ghét
terms.exampleSentence: Because he always wound up kicking himself in the head when he tried to play soccer, Oswald began to abhor the sport.

terms.meaning: 1. (v.) to put up with; 2. (v.) to remain
terms.translation: 1. chịu đựng; 2. lưu lại, tồn tại
terms.exampleSentence: Though he did not agree with the decision, Chuck decided to abide by it. Despite the beating they’ve taken from the weather throughout the millennia, the mountains abide.

terms.translation: khốn khổ, đáng thương
terms.exampleSentence: After losing all her money, falling into a puddle, and breaking her ankle, Eloise was abject.

terms.translation: từ bỏ, khước từ
terms.exampleSentence: To prove his honesty, the President abjured the evil policies of his wicked predecessor.

terms.translation: sự từ bỏ tiện nghi cá nhân, sự hy sinh
terms.exampleSentence: The holy man slept on the floor, took only cold showers, and generally followed other practices of abnegation.

terms.meaning: (v.) to give up on a half-finished project or effort
terms.translation: hủy bỏ, ngừng giữa chừng (dự án, nỗ lực)
terms.exampleSentence: After they ran out of food, the men, attempting to jump rope around the world, had to abort and go home.

terms.translation: 1. rút ngắn, cắt bớt; 2. đã được rút ngắn
terms.exampleSentence: The publisher thought the dictionary was too long and abridged it. Moby-Dick is such a long book that even the abridged version is longer than most normal books.

terms.translation: bãi bỏ, hủy bỏ (thường do chính quyền)
terms.exampleSentence: The Bill of Rights assures that the government cannot abrogate our right to a free press.

terms.translation: bỏ trốn, lẩn trốn
terms.exampleSentence: In the confusion, the super-spy absconded into the night with the secret plans.

terms.translation: sự tha tội, sự miễn tội
terms.exampleSentence: Once all the facts were known, the jury gave Angela absolution by giving a verdict of not guilty.

terms.meaning: (v.) to freely choose not to commit an action
terms.translation: kiêng cữ, tự nguyện không làm gì
terms.exampleSentence: Everyone demanded that Angus put on the kilt, but he did not want to do it and abstained.

terms.translation: khó hiểu, thâm thúy
terms.exampleSentence: Everyone else in the class understood geometry easily, but John found the subject abstruse.

terms.translation: đồng ý, chấp thuận
terms.exampleSentence: When the class asked the teacher whether they could play baseball instead of learn grammar they expected him to refuse, but instead he acceded to their request.

terms.translation: nhấn mạnh, làm nổi bật
terms.exampleSentence: Psychologists agree that those people who are happiest accentuate the positive in life.

terms.translation: có thể tiếp cận được, có thể đạt được
terms.exampleSentence: After studying with SparkNotes and getting a great score on the SAT, Marlena happily realized that her goal of getting into an Ivy-League college was accessible.

terms.translation: sự hoan nghênh, ca ngợi
terms.exampleSentence: Greg’s excellent poem won the acclaim of his friends.

terms.translation: lời khen ngợi, giải thưởng danh dự
terms.exampleSentence: Everyone offered accolades to Sam after he won the Noble Prize.

terms.translation: sẵn lòng giúp đỡ, dễ dãi, lịch sự
terms.exampleSentence: Though the apartment was not big enough for three people, Arnold, Mark, and Zebulon were all friends and were accommodating to each other.

terms.translation: sự thỏa thuận, hiệp định
terms.exampleSentence: After much negotiating, England and Iceland finally came to a mutually beneficial accord about fishing rights off the cost of Greenland.

terms.translation: bắt chuyện, tiếp cận (một cách thách thức)
terms.exampleSentence: Though Antoinette was normally quite calm, when the waiter spilled soup on her for the fourth time in 15 minutes she stood up and accosted the man.

terms.meaning: (n.) slow growth in size or amount
terms.translation: sự tích tụ, sự tăng trưởng dần dần
terms.exampleSentence: Stalactites are formed by the accretion of minerals from the roofs of caves.

terms.meaning: (adj.) biting, bitter in tone or taste
terms.translation: chua chát, gay gắt (về giọng điệu, vị)
terms.exampleSentence: Jill became extremely acerbic and began to cruelly make fun of all her friends.

terms.translation: bằng lòng, chấp nhận mà không phản đối
terms.exampleSentence: Though Mr. Correlli wanted to stay outside and work in his garage, when his wife told him that he had better come in to dinner, he acquiesced to her demands.

terms.translation: sự gay gắt, sự bất hòa
terms.exampleSentence: Though they vowed that no girl would ever come between them, Biff and Trevor could not keep acrimony from overwhelming their friendship after they both fell in love with the lovely Teresa.

terms.translation: sự nhạy bén, sự sáng suốt
terms.exampleSentence: Because of his mathematical acumen, Larry was able to figure out in minutes problems that took other students hours.

terms.translation: 1. sắc bén, nghiêm trọng; 2. nhạy bén, tinh tường
terms.exampleSentence: Arnold could not walk because the pain in his foot was so acute. Because she was so acute, Libby instantly figured out how the magician pulled off his “magic.”

terms.translation: kiên quyết, không lay chuyển
terms.exampleSentence: Though public pressure was intense, the President remained adamant about his proposal.

terms.translation: thành thạo, lão luyện
terms.exampleSentence: Tarzan was adept at jumping from tree to tree like a monkey.

terms.meaning: 1. (n.) to stick to something; 2. (n.) to follow devoutly
terms.translation: 1. dính chặt vào; 2. tuân thủ nghiêm ngặt
terms.exampleSentence: We adhered the poster to the wall with tape. He adhered to the dictates of his religion without question.

terms.translation: khiển trách, cảnh cáo, quở trách
terms.exampleSentence: Joe’s mother admonished him not to ruin his appetite by eating cookies before dinner.

terms.translation: trang trí, tô điểm
terms.exampleSentence: We adorned the tree with ornaments.

terms.translation: khéo léo, tài tình
terms.exampleSentence: The adroit thief could pick someone’s pocket without attracting notice.

terms.translation: sự tâng bốc, sự ca tụng quá mức
terms.exampleSentence: Though the book was pretty good, Marcy did not believe it deserved the adulation it received.

terms.meaning: (v.) to sketch out in a vague way
terms.translation: phác thảo mơ hồ, báo trước
terms.exampleSentence: The coach adumbrated a game plan, but none of the players knew precisely what to do.

terms.translation: (adj.) đối địch, bất lợi, nguy hiểm.
terms.exampleSentence: Because of adverse conditions, the hikers decided to give up trying to climb the mountain.

terms.meaning: 1. (v.) to argue in favor of something; 2. (n.) a person who argues in favor of something
terms.translation: 1. (v.) ủng hộ, biện hộ cho; 2. (n.) người ủng hộ, người biện hộ.
terms.exampleSentence: Arnold advocated turning left at the stop sign, even though everyone else thought we should turn right. In addition to wanting to turn left at every stop sign, Arnold was also a great advocate of increasing national defense spending.

terms.translation: (adj.) liên quan đến không khí, trên không.
terms.exampleSentence: We watched as the fighter planes conducted aerial maneuvers.

terms.meaning: (adj.) artistic, related to the appreciation of beauty
terms.translation: (adj.) thuộc về nghệ thuật, liên quan đến sự thưởng thức cái đẹp; có tính thẩm mỹ.
terms.exampleSentence: We hired Susan as our interior decorator because she has such a fine aesthetic sense.

terms.translation: (adj.) thân thiện, dễ gần.
terms.exampleSentence: People like to be around George because he is so affable and good-natured.

terms.translation: (n.) sự gần gũi tự nhiên, sự đồng cảm.
terms.exampleSentence: Jerry didn’t know why, but he felt an incredible affinity for Kramer the first time they met.

terms.translation: (adj.) giàu có, sung túc.
terms.exampleSentence: Mrs. Grebelski was affluent, owning a huge house, three cars, and an island near Maine.

terms.translation: (n.) sự lăng mạ, sự sỉ nhục.
terms.exampleSentence: Bernardo was very touchy, and took any slight as an affront to his honor.

terms.translation: (v.) tăng cường, làm cho lớn hơn, khuếch đại.
terms.exampleSentence: Joseph always dropped the names of the famous people his father knew as a way to aggrandize his personal stature.

terms.meaning: 1. (n.) a whole or total; 2. (v.) to gather into a mass
terms.translation: 1. (n.) tổng thể, toàn bộ; 2. (v.) tập hợp lại, gom lại.
terms.exampleSentence: The three branches of the U.S. Government form an aggregate much more powerful than its individual parts. The dictator tried to aggregate as many people into his army as he possibly could.

terms.translation: (adj.) đau khổ, bị đối xử bất công, bị tổn thương.
terms.exampleSentence: The foreman mercilessly overworked his aggrieved employees.

terms.translation: (adj.) nhanh nhẹn, lanh lợi.
terms.exampleSentence: The dogs were too slow to catch the agile rabbit.

terms.meaning: (adj.) believing that the existence of God cannot be proven or disproven
terms.translation: (adj.) hoài nghi về sự tồn tại của Chúa (không thể chứng minh hay bác bỏ).
terms.exampleSentence: Joey’s parents are very religious, but he is agnostic.

terms.translation: (n.) nông nghiệp, nghề nông.
terms.exampleSentence: It was a huge step in the progress of civilization when tribes left hunting and gathering and began to develop more sustainable methods of obtaining food, such as agriculture.

terms.meaning: (n.) a passageway between rows of seats
terms.translation: (n.) lối đi giữa các hàng ghế (trên máy bay, rạp hát, siêu thị).
terms.exampleSentence: Once we got inside the stadium we walked down the aisle to our seats.

terms.translation: (n.) sự hăng hái, sự nhanh nhẹn.
terms.exampleSentence: For some reason, Chuck loved to help his mother whenever he could, so when his mother asked him to set the table he did so with alacrity.

terms.translation: (n.) bí danh, tên giả.
terms.exampleSentence: He snuck past the guards by using an alias and fake ID.

terms.translation: (v.) làm dịu đi, xoa dịu.
terms.exampleSentence: The chairman of the Federal Reserve gave a speech to try to allay investors’ fears about an economic downturn.

terms.translation: (v.) tuyên bố, cáo buộc (thường không có bằng chứng).
terms.exampleSentence: The policeman had alleged that Marshall committed the crime, but after the investigation turned up no evidence, Marshall was set free.

terms.translation: (v.) làm giảm nhẹ, làm dịu bớt.
terms.exampleSentence: This drug will alleviate the symptoms of the terrible disease, but only for a while.

terms.translation: (v.) phân bổ, cấp phát, dành riêng.
terms.exampleSentence: The Mayor allocated 30 percent of the funds for improving the town’s schools.

terms.translation: (adj.) xa cách, dè dặt, lạnh nhạt.
terms.exampleSentence: The scientist could sometimes seem aloof, as if he didn’t care about his friends or family, but really he was just thinking about quantum mechanics.

terms.translation: (n.) cuộc cãi vã, cuộc ẩu đả.
terms.exampleSentence: Jason and Lionel blamed one another for the car accident, leading to an altercation.

terms.translation: (v.) hợp nhất, sáp nhập.
terms.exampleSentence: Because of his great charisma, the presidential candidate was able to amalgamate all democrats and republicans under his banner.

terms.translation: (adj.) mơ hồ, không rõ ràng, có thể hiểu theo nhiều cách.
terms.exampleSentence: Some people think Caesar married Cleopatra for her power, others believe he was charmed by her beauty. His actual reasons are ambiguous.

terms.translation: (adj.) mâu thuẫn trong cảm xúc, vừa yêu vừa ghét.
terms.exampleSentence: My feelings about Calvin are ambivalent because on one hand he is a loyal friend, but on the other, he is a cruel and vicious thief.

terms.translation: (v.) cải thiện, làm tốt hơn.
terms.exampleSentence: The tense situation was ameliorated when Sam proposed a solution everyone could agree upon.

terms.translation: (adj.) dễ bảo, dễ thuyết phục, sẵn lòng tuân theo.
terms.exampleSentence: Our father was amenable when we asked him to drive us to the farm so we could go apple picking.

terms.translation: (n.) tiện nghi, tiện ích (làm tăng sự thoải mái).
terms.exampleSentence: Bill Gates’s house is stocked with so many amenities, he never has to do anything for himself.

terms.translation: (adj.) thân thiện, dễ mến.
terms.exampleSentence: An amiable fellow, Harry got along with just about everyone.

terms.translation: (adj.) thân thiện, hòa nhã (thường dùng cho mối quan hệ).
terms.exampleSentence: Claudia and Jimmy got divorced, but amicably and without hard feelings.

terms.translation: (adj.) biểu lộ tình yêu, đặc biệt là tình yêu thể xác.
terms.exampleSentence: Whenever Albert saw Mariah wear her slinky red dress, he began to feel quite amorous.

terms.translation: (adj.) vô định hình, không có hình dạng rõ ràng.
terms.exampleSentence: The effort was doomed from the start, because the reasons behind it were so amorphous and hard to pin down.

terms.meaning: (adj.) being out of correct chronological order
terms.translation: (adj.) lỗi thời, không đúng thời đại.
terms.exampleSentence: In this book you’re writing, you say that the Pyramids were built after the Titanic sank, which is anachronistic.

terms.translation: (n.) thuốc giảm đau, chất làm giảm đau.
terms.exampleSentence: Put this analgesic on the wound so that the poor man at least feels a little better.

terms.meaning: (adj.) similar to, so that an analogy can be drawn
terms.translation: (adj.) tương tự, tương đồng (có thể so sánh).
terms.exampleSentence: Though they are unrelated genetically, the bone structure of whales and fish is quite analogous.

terms.meaning: (n.) one who wants to eliminate all government
terms.translation: (n.) người theo chủ nghĩa vô chính phủ.
terms.exampleSentence: An anarchist, Carmine wanted to dissolve every government everywhere.

terms.translation: (n.) người hoặc vật bị nguyền rủa, bị ghét bỏ.
terms.exampleSentence: I never want to see that murderer. He is an anathema to me.

terms.translation: (n.) giai thoại, chuyện vặt (ngắn, hài hước).
terms.exampleSentence: After dinner, Marlon told an anecdote about the time he got his nose stuck in a toaster.

terms.translation: (n.) sự mất cảm giác, sự gây mê.
terms.exampleSentence: When the nerves in his spine were damaged, Mr. Hollins suffered anesthesia in his legs.

terms.translation: nỗi đau khổ tột cùng, sự giày vò
terms.exampleSentence: Angelos suffered terrible anguish when he learned that Buffy had died while combating a strange mystical force of evil.

terms.translation: sống động, đầy sức sống
terms.exampleSentence: When he begins to talk about drama, which is his true passion, he becomes very animated.

terms.meaning: 1. (v.) to incorporate territory or space; 2. (n.) a room attached to a larger room or space
terms.translation: 1. (v.) sáp nhập lãnh thổ hoặc không gian; 2. (n.) phòng phụ, phần mở rộng của một căn phòng lớn hơn
terms.exampleSentence: After defeating them in battle, the Russians annexed Poland. He likes to do his studying in a little annex attached to the main reading room in the library.

terms.translation: hủy bỏ, tuyên bố vô hiệu
terms.exampleSentence: After seeing its unforeseen and catastrophic effects, Congress sought to annul the law.

terms.meaning: (n.) something that does not fit into the normal order
terms.translation: sự bất thường, điều không phù hợp với quy luật thông thường
terms.exampleSentence: “That rip in the space- time continuum is certainly a spatial anomaly,” said Spock to Captain Kirk.

terms.translation: ẩn danh, vô danh, không được nhận diện
terms.exampleSentence: Mary received a love poem from an anonymous admirer.

terms.translation: sự đối kháng, thù địch
terms.exampleSentence: Superman and Bizarro Superman shared a mutual antagonism, and often fought.

terms.translation: tiền lệ, cái có trước
terms.exampleSentence: The great tradition of Western culture had its antecedent in the culture of Ancient Greece.

terms.translation: cổ xưa, lỗi thời
terms.exampleSentence: The antediluvian man still believed that Eisenhower was president of the United States and that hot dogs cost a nickel.

terms.meaning: (n.) a selected collection of writings, songs, etc.
terms.translation: tuyển tập các tác phẩm văn học, bài hát, v.v.
terms.exampleSentence: The new anthology of Bob Dylan songs contains all his greatest hits and a few songs that you might never have heard before.

terms.translation: sự ác cảm sâu sắc, ghét bỏ
terms.exampleSentence: I know you love me, but because you are a liar and a thief, I feel nothing but antipathy for you.

terms.translation: cũ kỹ, lỗi thời
terms.exampleSentence: That antiquated car has none of the features, like power windows and steering, that make modern cars so great.

terms.translation: sạch sẽ, vô trùng
terms.exampleSentence: The antiseptic hospital was very bare, but its cleanliness helped to keep patients healthy.

terms.translation: sự đối lập hoàn toàn, phản đề
terms.exampleSentence: Your values, which hold war and violence in the highest esteem, are the antithesis of my pacifist beliefs.

terms.translation: sự lo lắng tột độ, bồn chồn
terms.exampleSentence: When he heard about the car crash, he felt anxiety because he knew that his girlfriend had been driving on the road where the accident occurred.

terms.translation: thờ ơ, vô cảm, thiếu quan tâm
terms.exampleSentence: Uninterested in politics, Bruno was apathetic about whether he lived under a capitalist or communist regime.

terms.translation: bịa đặt, sai sự thật, không đáng tin
terms.exampleSentence: Because I am standing before you, it seems obvious that the stories circulating about my demise were apocryphal.

terms.translation: gây sốc, kinh hoàng, ghê tởm
terms.exampleSentence: The judge found the murderer’s crimes and lack of remorse appalling.

terms.translation: xoa dịu, làm hài lòng
terms.exampleSentence: When the child cries, the mother gives him candy to appease him.

terms.meaning: (v.) to assess the worth or value of
terms.translation: đánh giá giá trị
terms.exampleSentence: A realtor will come over tonight to appraise our house.

terms.meaning: 1. (v.) to seize, arrest; 2. (v.) to perceive, understand, grasp
terms.translation: 1. (v.) bắt giữ, tóm; 2. (v.) nhận thức, hiểu rõ, nắm bắt
terms.exampleSentence: The criminal was apprehended at the scene. The student has trouble apprehending concepts in math and science.

terms.translation: sự tán thành, khen ngợi
terms.exampleSentence: The crowd welcomed the heroes with approbation.

terms.translation: chiếm đoạt, sử dụng
terms.exampleSentence: The government appropriated the farmer’s land without justification.

terms.translation: sống dưới nước, liên quan đến nước
terms.exampleSentence: The marine biologist studies starfish and other aquatic creatures.

terms.translation: có thể trồng trọt được, màu mỡ
terms.exampleSentence: The farmer purchased a plot of arable land on which he will grow corn and sprouts.

terms.meaning: (n.) one who can resolve a dispute, make a decision
terms.translation: trọng tài, người phân xử tranh chấp
terms.exampleSentence: The divorce court judge will serve as the arbiter between the estranged husband and wife.

terms.meaning: (adj.) based on factors that appear random
terms.translation: tùy tiện, ngẫu nhiên, không theo quy tắc
terms.exampleSentence: The boy’s decision to choose one college over another seems arbitrary.

terms.meaning: (n.) the process or act of resolving a dispute
terms.translation: sự phân xử, hòa giải tranh chấp
terms.exampleSentence: The employee sought official arbitration when he could not resolve a disagreement with his supervisor.

terms.translation: thuộc về cây cối, sống trên cây
terms.exampleSentence: Leaves, roots, and bark are a few arboreal traits.

terms.meaning: (adj.) obscure, secret, known only by a few
terms.translation: bí ẩn, bí mật, chỉ một số ít người biết
terms.exampleSentence: The professor is an expert in arcane Lithuanian literature.

terms.meaning: (adj.) of or relating to an earlier period in time, outdated
terms.translation: cổ xưa, lỗi thời, thuộc về thời kỳ trước
terms.exampleSentence: In a few select regions of Western Mongolian, an archaic Chinese dialect is still spoken.

terms.meaning: (adj.) the most representative or typical example of something
terms.translation: nguyên mẫu, điển hình nhất của một cái gì đó
terms.exampleSentence: Some believe George Washington, with his flowing white hair and commanding stature, was the archetypal politician.

terms.translation: sự nhiệt huyết, năng lượng, hăng hái tột độ
terms.exampleSentence: The soldiers conveyed their ardor with impassioned battle cries.

terms.translation: khô cằn, khô hạn quá mức
terms.exampleSentence: Little other than palm trees and cacti grow successfully in arid environments.

terms.translation: chiếm đoạt, giành lấy mà không có lý do chính đáng
terms.exampleSentence: The king arrogated the right to order executions to himself exclusively.

terms.meaning: (n.) a remaining piece from an extinct culture or place
terms.translation: cổ vật, di vật từ một nền văn hóa đã biến mất
terms.exampleSentence: The scientists spent all day searching the cave for artifacts from the ancient Mayan civilization.

terms.translation: thợ thủ công, nghệ nhân
terms.exampleSentence: The artisan uses wood to make walking sticks.

terms.translation: tìm hiểu chắc chắn, xác định, nhận ra
terms.exampleSentence: With a bit of research, the student ascertained that some plants can live for weeks without water.

terms.meaning: (adj.) practicing restraint as a means of self-discipline, usually religious
terms.translation: khổ hạnh, tu khổ hạnh (thường vì lý do tôn giáo)
terms.exampleSentence: The priest lives an ascetic life devoid of television, savory foods, and other pleasures.

terms.translation: gán cho, quy cho, đổ cho
terms.exampleSentence: Some ascribe the invention of fireworks and dynamite to the Chinese.

terms.translation: lời nguyền rủa, sự phỉ báng, lời nói xấu
terms.exampleSentence: The rival politicians repeatedly cast aspersions on each others’ integrity.

terms.translation: khao khát, mong muốn, hướng tới
terms.exampleSentence: The young poet aspires to publish a book of verse someday.

terms.translation: tấn công, công kích
terms.exampleSentence: At dawn, the war planes assailed the boats in the harbor.

terms.translation: đánh giá, định giá
terms.exampleSentence: A crew arrived to assess the damage after the crash.

terms.translation: siêng năng, cần cù, chăm chỉ
terms.exampleSentence: The construction workers erected the skyscraper during two years of assiduous labor.

terms.translation: làm dịu đi, xoa dịu
terms.exampleSentence: The mother held the baby to assuage its fears.

terms.translation: sắc sảo, tinh ranh, khôn ngoan
terms.exampleSentence: Much of Roger’s success in politics results from his ability to provide astute answers to reporters’ questions.

terms.meaning: 1. (n.) a place of refuge, protection, a sanctuary; 2. (n.) an institution in which the insane are kept
terms.translation: 1. nơi trú ẩn, nơi ẩn náu, nơi bảo vệ; 2. bệnh viện tâm thần
terms.exampleSentence: For Thoreau, the forest served as an asylum from the pressures of urban life. Once diagnosed by a certified psychiatrist, the man was put in an asylum.

terms.exampleSentence: When she found out she had won the lottery, the writer was elated.

terms.meaning: (n.) a speech given in honor of a dead person
terms.translation: bài điếu văn, bài thơ ca ngợi người đã khuất
terms.exampleSentence: At the funeral, the widow gave a moving elegy describing her love for her husband.

terms.meaning: (v.) to bring forth, draw out, evoke
terms.translation: Gợi ra, khơi gợi, làm lộ ra.
terms.exampleSentence: Although I asked several times where the exit was, I elicited no response from the stone-faced policeman.

terms.translation: Hùng hồn, có khả năng diễn đạt lưu loát, gây xúc động.
terms.exampleSentence: The priest gave such an eloquent sermon that most churchgoers were crying.

terms.translation: Làm sáng tỏ, giải thích rõ ràng.
terms.exampleSentence: I didn’t understand why my friend was so angry with me, so I asked Janine to elucidate her feelings.

terms.translation: Trốn tránh, lẩn tránh, thoát khỏi.
terms.exampleSentence: Despite an intense search, the robber continues to elude the police.

terms.translation: Gầy gò, ốm yếu, tiều tụy.
terms.exampleSentence: My sister eats a lot of pastries and chocolate but still looks emaciated.

terms.meaning: 1. (v.) to decorate, adorn; 2. (v.) to add details to, enhance
terms.translation: 1. Trang trí, tô điểm; 2. Thêm thắt chi tiết, làm cho hay hơn.
terms.exampleSentence: My mom embellished the living room by adding lace curtains. When Harry told me that he had “done stuff” on his vacation, I asked him to embellish upon his account.

terms.meaning: (v.) to steal money by falsifying records
terms.translation: Biển thủ, tham ô (tiền bằng cách giả mạo hồ sơ).
terms.exampleSentence: The accountant was fired for embezzling $10,000 of the company’s funds.

terms.meaning: (v.) to correct or revise a written text
terms.translation: Sửa chữa, hiệu đính (văn bản).
terms.exampleSentence: If my sentence is incorrect, the editor will emend what I have written.

terms.translation: 1. Nổi bật, xuất chúng, nổi tiếng; 2. Dễ thấy, rõ ràng.
terms.exampleSentence: Mr. Phillips is such an eminent scholar that every professor on campus has come to hear him lecture. There is an eminent stain on that shirt.

terms.translation: Làm dịu, làm mềm.
terms.exampleSentence: This emollient cream makes my skin very smooth.

terms.translation: Bộc lộ cảm xúc, biểu lộ tình cảm.
terms.exampleSentence: The director told the actor he had to emote, or else the audience would have no idea what his character was going through.

terms.meaning: (n.) sensitivity to another’s feelings as if they were one’s own
terms.translation: Sự đồng cảm, khả năng thấu hiểu cảm xúc của người khác như của chính mình.
terms.exampleSentence: I feel such empathy for my sister when she’s in pain that I cry too.

terms.meaning: 1. (adj.) based on observation or experience; 2. (adj.) capable of being proved or disproved by experiment
terms.translation: 1. Dựa trên quan sát hoặc kinh nghiệm; 2. Có thể kiểm chứng bằng thực nghiệm.
terms.exampleSentence: The scientist gathered empirical data on the growth rate of dandelions by studying the dandelions behind his house. That all cats hate getting wet is an empirical statement: I can test it by bathing my cat, Trinket.

terms.translation: Bắt chước, cạnh tranh để vượt qua.
terms.exampleSentence: I idolize Britney Spears so much that I emulate everything she does: I wear her outfits, sing along to her songs, and date a boy named Justin.

terms.meaning: (v.) to fill with love, fascinate, usually used in passive form followed by “of” or “with”
terms.translation: Làm cho say mê, yêu thích, quyến rũ (thường dùng ở dạng bị động với “of” hoặc “with”).
terms.exampleSentence: I grew enamored of that boy when he quoted my favorite love poem.

terms.meaning: (n.) the audience’s demand for a repeat performance; also the artist’s performance in response to that demand
terms.translation: Yêu cầu biểu diễn lại của khán giả; hoặc màn biểu diễn lại của nghệ sĩ đáp lại yêu cầu đó.
terms.exampleSentence: At the end of the concert, all the fans yelled, “Encore! Encore!” but the band did not come out to play again.

terms.translation: Gây trở ngại, làm vướng víu, đè nặng.
terms.exampleSentence: At the airport, my friend was encumbered by her luggage, so I offered to carry two of her bags.

terms.translation: Làm suy yếu, làm kiệt sức.
terms.exampleSentence: Writing these sentences enervates me so much that I will have to take a nap after I finish.

terms.translation: Ban quyền bầu cử cho.
terms.exampleSentence: The Nineteenth Amendment enfranchised women.

terms.translation: Gây ra, tạo ra, sản sinh ra.
terms.exampleSentence: During the Olympics, the victories of U.S. athletes engender a patriotic spirit among Americans.

terms.translation: Bí ẩn, khó hiểu, khó giải thích.
terms.exampleSentence: That man wearing the dark suit and dark glasses is so enigmatic that no one even knows his name.

terms.translation: Sự thù địch, lòng căm ghét, ác ý.
terms.exampleSentence: Mark and Andy have clearly not forgiven each other, because the enmity between them is obvious to anyone in their presence.

terms.translation: Sự buồn chán, sự mệt mỏi.
terms.exampleSentence: I feel such ennui that I don’t look forward to anything, not even my birthday party.

terms.meaning: (v.) to include as a necessary step
terms.translation: Đòi hỏi, kéo theo, bao gồm như một bước cần thiết.
terms.exampleSentence: Building a new fence entails tearing down the old one.

terms.translation: Mê hoặc, quyến rũ, làm say đắm.
terms.exampleSentence: The sailor’s stories of fighting off sharks and finding ancient treasures enthralled his young son.

terms.translation: Ngắn ngủi, phù du, chóng tàn.
terms.exampleSentence: She promised she’d love me forever, but her “forever” was only ephemeral: she left me after one week.

terms.meaning: (adj.) relating to or contained in letters
terms.translation: Thuộc về thư từ, dưới dạng thư.
terms.exampleSentence: Some people call me “Auntie’s boy,” because my aunt and I have such a close epistolary relationship that we write each other every day.

terms.translation: Hình mẫu hoàn hảo, điển hình, hiện thân.
terms.exampleSentence: My mother, the epitome of good taste, always dresses more elegantly than I do.

terms.translation: Sự bình tĩnh, điềm tĩnh.
terms.exampleSentence: Even though he had just been fired, Mr. Simms showed great equanimity by neatly packing up his desk and wishing everyone in the office well.

terms.translation: Mơ hồ, không rõ ràng, không chắc chắn.
terms.exampleSentence: His intentions were so equivocal that I didn’t know whether he was being chivalrous or sleazy.

terms.translation: Uyên bác, thông thái.
terms.exampleSentence: My Latin teacher is such an erudite scholar that he has translated some of the most difficult and abstruse ancient poetry.

terms.translation: Tránh xa, kiêng cữ, từ bỏ.
terms.exampleSentence: George hates the color green so much that he eschews all green food.

terms.meaning: (adj.) understood by only a select few
terms.translation: Bí truyền, chỉ một số ít người hiểu được.
terms.exampleSentence: Even the most advanced students cannot understand the physicist’s esoteric theories.

terms.meaning: (v.) to take up as a cause, support
terms.translation: Tán thành, ủng hộ, theo (một quan điểm, lý tưởng).
terms.exampleSentence: I love animals so much that I espouse animal rights.

terms.translation: Thanh tao, nhẹ nhàng, tinh tế, siêu trần tục.
terms.exampleSentence: In her flowing silk gown and lace veil, the bride looked ethereal.

terms.meaning: (n.) the history of words, their origin and development
terms.translation: Ngành nghiên cứu từ nguyên, lịch sử và sự phát triển của từ ngữ.
terms.exampleSentence: From the study of etymology, I know that the word “quixotic” derives from Don Quixote and the word “gaudy” refers to the Spanish architect Gaudí.

terms.translation: Hưng phấn, phấn khởi tột độ.
terms.exampleSentence: I was euphoric when I found out that my sister had given birth to twins.

terms.translation: Thoáng qua, phù du, chóng tàn.
terms.exampleSentence: My joy at getting promoted was evanescent because I discovered that I would have to work much longer hours in a less friendly office.

terms.translation: Bộc lộ, biểu lộ, cho thấy.
terms.exampleSentence: Christopher’s hand-wringing and nail-biting evince how nervous he is about the upcoming English test.

terms.translation: Làm trầm trọng thêm, làm tệ hơn.
terms.exampleSentence: The gruesome and scary movie I saw last night exacerbated my fears of the dark.

terms.translation: Tôn vinh, ca ngợi.
terms.exampleSentence: Michael Jordan is the figure in basketball we exalt the most.

terms.translation: Chọc tức, làm bực mình.
terms.exampleSentence: George’s endless complaints exasperated his roomate.

terms.meaning: (v.) to dig out of the ground and remove
terms.translation: Đào bới, khai quật.
terms.exampleSentence: The pharaoh’s treasures were excavated by archeologists in Egypt.

terms.meaning: (v.) to free from guilt or blame, exonerate
terms.translation: Minh oan, tuyên bố vô tội.
terms.exampleSentence: My discovery of the ring behind the dresser exculpated me from the charge of having stolen it.

terms.translation: Chuyến đi chơi, dã ngoại.
terms.exampleSentence: After taking an excursion to the Bronx Zoo, I dreamed about pandas and monkeys.

terms.translation: Đáng ghét, kinh tởm.
terms.exampleSentence: Her pudding is so execrable that it makes me sick.

terms.translation: Thúc giục, khuyến khích.
terms.exampleSentence: Henry exhorted his colleagues to join him in protesting against the university’s hiring policies.

terms.translation: Khẩn cấp, cấp bách.
terms.exampleSentence: The patient has an exigent need for medication, or else he will lose his sight.

terms.meaning: (v.) to free from guilt or blame, exculpate
terms.translation: Minh oan, tuyên bố vô tội.
terms.exampleSentence: The true thief ’s confession exonerated the man who had been held in custody for the crime.

terms.translation: Quá mức, cắt cổ (giá).
terms.exampleSentence: Her exorbitant praise made me blush and squirm in my seat.

terms.translation: Có lợi, thích hợp, vì lợi ích cá nhân.
terms.exampleSentence: In his bid for reelection, the governor made an expedient move by tabling all controversial legislation.

terms.translation: Sám hối, chuộc lỗi.
terms.exampleSentence: To expiate my selfishness, I gave all my profits to charity.

terms.translation: Xóa bỏ, loại bỏ hoàn toàn.
terms.exampleSentence: Fearful of an IRS investigation, Paul tried to expunge all incriminating evidence from his tax files.

terms.meaning: (v.) to remove offensive or incorrect parts, usually of a book
terms.translation: Cắt bỏ, loại bỏ phần không phù hợp (thường trong sách).
terms.exampleSentence: The history editors expurgated from the text all disparaging and inflammatory comments about the Republican Party.

terms.translation: Hiện có, còn tồn tại.
terms.exampleSentence: My mother’s extant love letters to my father are in the attic trunk.

terms.translation: Ca ngợi, tôn sùng.
terms.exampleSentence: Violet extolled the virtues of a vegetarian diet to her meat- loving brother.

terms.translation: Không liên quan, thừa thãi, không cần thiết.
terms.exampleSentence: Personal political ambitions should always remain extraneous to legislative policy, but, unfortunately, they rarely are.

terms.translation: Gỡ rối, giải thoát.
terms.exampleSentence: Instead of trying to mediate between my brother and sister, I extricated myself from the family tension entirely and left the house for the day.

terms.translation: Hân hoan, vui mừng khôn xiết.
terms.exampleSentence: When she found out she won the literature prize, Mary exulted by dancing and singing through the school’s halls.

terms.translation: Bịa đặt, ngụy tạo.
terms.exampleSentence: When I arrived an hour late to class, I fabricated some excuse about my car breaking down on the way to school.

terms.meaning: 1. (n.) the wall of a building; 2. (n.) a deceptive appearance or attitude
terms.translation: 1. Mặt tiền (tòa nhà); 2. Vẻ ngoài giả dối, che đậy.
terms.exampleSentence: Meet me in front of the museum’s main façade. Despite my smiling façade, I am feeling melancholy.

terms.meaning: 1. (adj.) easy, requiring little effort; 2. (adj.) superficial, achieved with minimal thought or care, insincere
terms.translation: 1. Dễ dàng, không tốn sức; 2. Hời hợt, nông cạn, thiếu chân thành.
terms.exampleSentence: This game is so facile that even a four-year- old can master it. The business was in such shambles that any solution seemed facile at best; nothing could really helpit in the long-run.

terms.translation: Sai lầm, gây hiểu lầm.
terms.exampleSentence: Emily offered me cigarettes on the fallacious assumption that I smoked.

terms.meaning: (adj.) meticulous, demanding, having high and often unattainable standards
terms.translation: Kỹ tính, khó tính, cầu kỳ, có tiêu chuẩn cao.
terms.exampleSentence: Mark is so fastidious that he is never able to finish a project because it always seems imperfect to him.

terms.translation: Hiểu thấu, nắm bắt.
terms.exampleSentence: I cannot fathom why you like that crabby and mean-spirited neighbor of ours.

terms.translation: Ngớ ngẩn, ngu xuẩn.
terms.exampleSentence: He considers himself a serious poet, but in truth, he only writes fatuous limericks.

terms.translation: Màu mỡ, phong phú, mắn đẻ.
terms.exampleSentence: The fecund tree bore enough apples to last us through the entire season.

terms.translation: 1. Thích hợp, khéo léo; 2. Dễ chịu, vui vẻ.
terms.exampleSentence: While his comments were idiotic and rambling, mine were felicitous and helpful. I spent a felicitous afternoon visiting old friends.

terms.translation: Hoang dã, hung dữ.
terms.exampleSentence: That beast looks so feral that I would fear being alone with it.

terms.translation: Nồng nhiệt, say mê.
terms.exampleSentence: The fervent protestors chained themselves to the building and shouted all night long.

terms.translation: Có mùi hôi thối.
terms.exampleSentence: I can tell from the fetid smell in your refrigerator that your milk has spoiled.

terms.translation: Xiềng xích, kiềm chế.
terms.exampleSentence: The dog was fettered to the parking meter.

terms.translation: Hay thay đổi, không kiên định.
terms.exampleSentence: In Greek dramas, the fickle gods help Achilles one day, and then harm him the next.

terms.translation: Lòng trung thành, sự tận tụy.
terms.exampleSentence: Guard dogs are known for the great fidelity they show toward their masters.

terms.translation: Mang tính biểu tượng, ẩn dụ.
terms.exampleSentence: Using figurative language, Jane likened the storm to an angry bull.

terms.translation: Sửng sốt, kinh ngạc.
terms.exampleSentence: Whenever I read an Agatha Christie mystery novel, I am always flabbergasted when I learn the identity of the murderer.

terms.translation: Mềm nhũn, yếu ớt.
terms.exampleSentence: If a plant is not watered enough, its leaves become droopy and flaccid.

terms.translation: Trắng trợn, hiển nhiên (lỗi lầm).
terms.exampleSentence: The judge’s decision to set the man free simply because that man was his brother was a flagrant abuse of power.

terms.translation: Hoa mỹ, cầu kỳ.
terms.exampleSentence: The writer’s florid prose belongs on a sentimental Hallmark card.

terms.translation: Công khai coi thường, bất tuân.
terms.exampleSentence: I flouted the school’s dress code by wearing a tie-dyed tank top and a pair of cut-off jeans.

terms.translation: Ngăn chặn, làm thất bại, đánh bại.
terms.exampleSentence: Inspector Wilkens foiled the thieves by locking them in the bank along with their stolen money.

terms.translation: Tìm kiếm thức ăn, lục lọi thức ăn.
terms.exampleSentence: When we got lost on our hiking trip, we foraged for berries and nuts in order to survive.

terms.translation: Sự kiên nhẫn, sự kiềm chế, sự chịu đựng.
terms.exampleSentence: The doctor showed great forbearance in calming down the angry patient who shouted insults at him.

terms.translation: Ngăn chặn, cản trở, trì hoãn.
terms.exampleSentence: I forestalled the cold I was getting by taking plenty of vitamin C pills and wearing a scarf.

terms.translation: Cô đơn, bị bỏ rơi, vô vọng.
terms.exampleSentence: Even though I had the flu, my family decided to go skiing for the weekend and leave me home alone, feeling feverish and forlorn.

terms.translation: Từ bỏ, khước từ.
terms.exampleSentence: My New Year’s resolution is to forsake smoking and drinking.

terms.translation: Sức mạnh tinh thần, sự dũng cảm.
terms.exampleSentence: Achilles’ fortitude in battle is legendary.

terms.meaning: (adj.) happening by chance, often lucky or fortunate
terms.translation: Xảy ra tình cờ, thường là may mắn hoặc thuận lợi.
terms.exampleSentence: After looking for Manuel and not finding him at home, Harriet had a fortuitous encounter with him at the post office.

terms.meaning: (n.) a medium for lecture or discussion
terms.translation: Diễn đàn, nơi để thuyết trình hoặc thảo luận.
terms.exampleSentence: Some radio talk-shows provide a good forum for political debate.

terms.translation: Kích thích, thúc đẩy, khuyến khích.
terms.exampleSentence: To fostergood health in the city, the mayor started a “Get out and exercise!” campaign.

terms.translation: Khó chịu, dễ cáu kỉnh.
terms.exampleSentence: Although the child insisted he wasn’t tired, his fractious behavior—especially his decision to crush his cheese and crackers all over the floor—convinced everyone present that it was time to put him to bed.

terms.meaning: (adj.) (usually used with “with”) filled or accompanied with
terms.translation: Đầy rẫy, đi kèm với (thường dùng với “with”).
terms.exampleSentence: Her glances in his direction were fraught with meaning, though precisely what meaning remained unclear.

terms.translation: Cuồng nhiệt, bận rộn, điên cuồng.
terms.exampleSentence: In the hours between night and morning, the frenetic pace of city life slows to a lull.

terms.translation: Tầm thường, không quan trọng.
terms.exampleSentence: Someday, all that anxiety about whether your zit will disappear before the prom will seem totally frivolous.

terms.translation: Tiết kiệm, thanh đạm.
terms.exampleSentence: Richard is so frugal that his diet consists almost exclusively of catfish and chicken liver—the two most inexpensive foods in the store.

terms.translation: Lén lút, bí mật.
terms.exampleSentence: Jane’s placement of her drugs in her sock drawer was not as furtive as she thought, as the sock drawer is the first place most parents look.

terms.translation: Lòe loẹt, phô trương, kém sang.
terms.exampleSentence: Mrs. Watson has poor taste and covers every object in her house with a garish gold lamé.

terms.translation: Ba hoa, nói nhiều.
terms.exampleSentence: Some talk show hosts are so garrulous that their guests can’t get a word in edgewise.

terms.translation: Thân thiện, hòa nhã.
terms.exampleSentence: Although he’s been known to behave like a real jerk, I would say that my brother is an overall genial guy.

terms.translation: Sự ăn uống vô độ, tham ăn.
terms.exampleSentence: Ada’s fried chicken tastes so divine, I don’t know how anyone can call gluttony a sin.

terms.meaning: (v.) to urge, spur, incite to action
terms.translation: Thúc giục, khuyến khích, kích động hành động.
terms.exampleSentence: Jim may think he’s not going to fight Billy, but Billy will goad Jim on with insults until he throws a punch.

terms.meaning: (n.) someone fond of eating and drinking
terms.translation: Người sành ăn uống, người ham ăn.
terms.exampleSentence: My parents, who used to eat little more than crackers and salad, have become real gourmands in their old age.

terms.translation: Ngôn ngữ khoa trương, hùng hồn.
terms.exampleSentence: The student thought her grandiloquence would make her sound smart, but neither the class nor the teacher bought it.

terms.meaning: (adj.) on a magnificent or exaggerated scale
terms.translation: Hoành tráng, vĩ đại hoặc phóng đại.
terms.exampleSentence: Margaret planned a grandiose party, replete with elephants, trapeze artists, and clowns.

terms.translation: Vô cớ, không cần thiết, không chính đáng.
terms.exampleSentence: Every morning the guy at the donut shop gives me a gratuitous helping of ketchup packets.

terms.meaning: (adj.) drawn to the company of others, sociable
terms.translation: Thích giao du, hòa đồng.
terms.exampleSentence: Well, if you’re not gregarious, I don’t know why you would want to go to a singles party!

terms.meaning: (adj.) injurious, hurtful; serious or grave in nature
terms.translation: Gây tổn hại, đau buồn; nghiêm trọng.
terms.exampleSentence: Electrocuting the inmate without being sure of his guilt would be a truly grievous mistake.

terms.translation: Sự lừa dối, xảo quyệt, ranh mãnh.
terms.exampleSentence: Because of his great guile, the politician was able to survive scandal after scandal.

terms.translation: Sáo rỗng, cũ rích, không độc đáo.
terms.exampleSentence: A girl can only hear “I love you” so many times before it begins to sound hackneyed and meaningless.

terms.translation: Linh thiêng, được tôn kính.
terms.exampleSentence: In the hallowed corridors of the cathedral, the disturbed professor felt himself to be at peace.

terms.translation: Không may mắn, bất hạnh.
terms.exampleSentence: My poor, hapless family never seems to pick a sunny week to go on vacation.

terms.meaning: 1. (n.) a ranting speech; 2. (v.) to give such a speech
terms.translation: 1. (n.) Bài diễn văn hùng hồn, chỉ trích; 2. (v.) Diễn thuyết hùng hồn, chỉ trích.
terms.exampleSentence: Everyone had heard the teacher’s harangue about gum chewing in class before. But this time the teacher harangued the class about the importance of brushing your teeth after chewing gum.

terms.meaning: (adj.) robust, capable of surviving through adverse conditions
terms.translation: Cứng cáp, khỏe mạnh, có khả năng sống sót trong điều kiện khắc nghiệt.
terms.exampleSentence: I too would have expected the plants to be dead by mid-November, but apparently they’re very hardy.

terms.translation: Đau khổ tột cùng, gây phiền muộn.
terms.exampleSentence: The car crash was a harrowing experience, but I have a feeling that the increase in my insurance premiums will be even more upsetting.

terms.translation: Kiêu căng, ngạo mạn.
terms.exampleSentence: The superstar’s haughty dismissal of her costars will backfire on her someday.

terms.meaning: (n.) one who believes pleasure should be the primary pursuit of humans
terms.translation: Người theo chủ nghĩa khoái lạc, người coi khoái lạc là mục tiêu chính.
terms.exampleSentence: Because he’s such a hedonist, I knew Murray would appreciate the 11 cases of wine I bought him for his birthday.

terms.translation: Quyền bá chủ, sự thống trị.
terms.exampleSentence: Britain’s hegemony over its colonies was threatened once nationalist sentiment began to spread around the world.

terms.translation: Tàn ác, ghê tởm một cách đáng kinh ngạc.
terms.exampleSentence: The killings were made all the more heinous by the fact that the murderer first tortured his victims for three days.

terms.translation: Đa dạng, không đồng nhất về tính chất.
terms.exampleSentence: I hate having only one flavor so I always buy the swirled, or should I say heterogeneous, type of ice cream.

terms.meaning: (n.) a break or gap in duration or continuity
terms.translation: Khoảng ngừng, gián đoạn.
terms.exampleSentence: The hiatus in service should last two or three months—until the cable lines are repaired .

terms.meaning: (n.) a system with ranked groups, usually according to social, economic, or professional class
terms.translation: Hệ thống các nhóm được xếp hạng, thường theo địa vị xã hội, kinh tế hoặc nghề nghiệp.
terms.exampleSentence: Women found it very difficult to break into the upper ranks of the department’s hierarchy.

terms.meaning: (n.) pretending to believe what one does not
terms.translation: Sự giả vờ tin vào điều mình không tin.
terms.exampleSentence: Once the politician began passing legislation that contradicted his campaign promises, his hypocrisy became apparent.

terms.meaning: (adj.) supposed or assumed true, but unproven
terms.translation: Giả định hoặc được cho là đúng nhưng chưa được chứng minh.
terms.exampleSentence: Even though it has been celebrated by seven major newspapers, that the drug will be a success when tested in humans is still hypothetical.

terms.meaning: (n.) one who attacks common beliefs or institutions
terms.translation: Người công kích các tín ngưỡng hoặc thể chế phổ biến.
terms.exampleSentence: Jane goes to one protest after another, but she seems to be an iconoclast rather than an activist with a progressive agenda.

terms.meaning: (adj.) peculiar to one person; highly individualized
terms.translation: Đặc trưng riêng của một người; mang tính cá nhân hóa cao.
terms.exampleSentence: I know you had trouble with the last test, but because your mistakes were highly idiosyncratic, I’m going to deny your request that the class be given a new test.

terms.meaning: (adj.) excessively worshipping one object or person
terms.translation: Thờ cúng quá mức một vật hoặc một người.
terms.exampleSentence: Xena’s idolatrous fawning over the band—following them on tour, starting their fan club, filming their documentary—is really beginning to get on my nerves.

terms.translation: Đáng xấu hổ, nhục nhã.
terms.exampleSentence: It was really ignominious to be kicked out of the dorm for having an illegal gas stove in my room.

terms.translation: Bị cấm, không được phép.
terms.exampleSentence: The fourth-grader learned many illicit words from a pamphlet that was being passed around school.

terms.translation: Đắm chìm, tập trung sâu sắc, cuốn hút.
terms.exampleSentence: After breaking up with her boyfriend, Nancy decided to immerse herself in her work in order to avoid crying.

terms.translation: Không thể thay đổi.
terms.exampleSentence: The laws of physics are immutable and constant.

terms.translation: Vô cảm, không dễ bị tổn thương hay đau khổ.
terms.exampleSentence: Stop being so impassive; it’s healthy to cry every now and then.

terms.translation: Hoàn hảo, không tì vết.
terms.exampleSentence: If your grades were as impeccable as your sister’s, then you too would receive a car for a graduation present.

terms.translation: Nghèo khó, túng thiếu.
terms.exampleSentence: “I fear he’s too impecunious to take me out tonight,” the bratty girl whined.

terms.meaning: 1. (adj.) necessary, pressing; 2. (n.) a rule, command, or order
terms.translation: 1. (tính từ) Cần thiết, cấp bách; 2. (danh từ) Quy tắc, mệnh lệnh.
terms.exampleSentence: It is imperative that you have these folders organized by midday. Her imperative to have the folders organized by midday was perceived as ridiculous by the others.

terms.translation: Hống hách, độc đoán.
terms.exampleSentence: The imperious nature of your manner led me to dislike you at once.

terms.translation: Vô lễ, xấc xược.
terms.exampleSentence: Most of your comments are so impertinent that I don’t wish to dignify them with an answer.

terms.translation: Không thể xuyên thủng, không bị ảnh hưởng.
terms.exampleSentence: Because of their thick layer of fur, many seals are almost impervious to the cold.

terms.translation: Bốc đồng; làm vội vàng.
terms.exampleSentence: Hilda’s hasty slaying of the king was an impetuous, thoughtless action.

terms.meaning: 1. (v.) to impact, affect, make an impression; 2. (v.) to encroach, infringe
terms.translation: 1. (động từ) Tác động, ảnh hưởng, gây ấn tượng; 2. (động từ) Xâm phạm, vi phạm.
terms.exampleSentence: The hail impinged the roof, leaving large dents. I apologize for impinging upon you like this, but I really need to use your bathroom. Now.

terms.meaning: (adj.) incapable of being appeased or mitigated
terms.translation: Không thể xoa dịu hoặc làm giảm nhẹ.
terms.exampleSentence: Watch out: once you shun Grandma’s cooking, she is totally implacable.

terms.meaning: 1. (n.) an instrument, utensil, tool; 2. (v.) to put into effect, to institute
terms.translation: 1. (danh từ) Dụng cụ, công cụ; 2. (động từ) Thực hiện, thi hành.
terms.exampleSentence: Do you have a knife or some other sort of implement that I could use to pry the lid off of this jar? After the first town curfew failed to stop the graffiti problem, the mayor implemented a new policy to use security cameras to catch perpetrators in the act.

terms.meaning: (v.) to involve in an incriminating way, incriminate
terms.translation: Liên lụy, dính líu vào một cách buộc tội.
terms.exampleSentence: Even though Tom wasn’t present at the time of the shooting, he was implicated by the evidence suggesting that he had supplied the shooters with guns.

terms.meaning: (adj.) understood but not outwardly obvious, implied
terms.translation: Ngầm hiểu nhưng không rõ ràng, hàm ý.
terms.exampleSentence: I know Professor Smith didn’t actually say not to write from personal experience, but I think such a message was implicit in her instruction to use scholarly sources.

terms.translation: Bất khả xâm phạm, không thể bị chiếm hoặc xuyên thủng.
terms.exampleSentence: Though the invaders used battering rams, catapults, and rain dances, the fortress proved impregnable and resisted all attacks.

terms.translation: Vô lễ, xấc xược, hỗn xược.
terms.exampleSentence: The impudent young man looked the princess up and down and told her she was hot even though she hadn’t asked him.

terms.translation: Đổ lỗi, quy cho.
terms.exampleSentence: The CEO imputed the many typos in the letter to his lazy secretary.

terms.translation: Ngớ ngẩn và vô nghĩa.
terms.exampleSentence: Some films are so inane that the psychology of the characters makes absolutely no sense.

terms.meaning: (adj.) incapable of expressing oneself clearly through speech
terms.translation: Không có khả năng diễn đạt rõ ràng bằng lời nói.
terms.exampleSentence: Though he spoke for over an hour, the lecturer was completely inarticulate and the students had no idea what he was talking about.

terms.meaning: 1. (adj.) existing in the flesh, embodied; 2. (v.) to give human form to
terms.translation: 1. (tính từ) Hiện thân, hóa thân; 2. (động từ) Hiện thân thành hình người.
terms.exampleSentence: In the church pageant, I play the role of greed incarnate. The alien evaded detection by incarnating himself in a human form.

terms.meaning: 1. (n.) a person who agitates; 2. (adj.) inflammatory, causing combustion
terms.translation: 1. (danh từ) Người kích động; 2. (tính từ) Gây cháy, kích động.
terms.exampleSentence: If we catch the incendiary who screamed “bomb” in the middle of the soccer match, we’re going to put him in jail. Gas and lighter fluid are incendiary materials that should be kept out of hot storage areas.

terms.translation: Không ngừng, liên miên.
terms.exampleSentence: We wanted to go outside and play, but the incessant rain kept us indoors for two days.

terms.meaning: (adj.) unformed or formless, in a beginning stage
terms.translation: Chưa hình thành hoặc không có hình dạng, ở giai đoạn ban đầu.
terms.exampleSentence: The country’s government is still inchoate and, because it has no great tradition, quite unstable.

terms.translation: Sắc sảo, rõ ràng, trực tiếp.
terms.exampleSentence: The discussion wasn’t going anywhere until her incisive comment allowed everyone to see what the true issues were.

terms.translation: Khuynh hướng, xu hướng.
terms.exampleSentence: Sarah has an inclination to see every foreign film she hears about, even when she’s sure that she won’t like it.

terms.translation: Không thể chối cãi, không thể tranh cãi.
terms.exampleSentence: Only stubborn Tina would attempt to disprove the incontrovertible laws of physics.

terms.translation: Không thể sửa chữa, hư hỏng.
terms.exampleSentence: You can buy Grandma nicotine gum all you want, but I think that after sixty-five years of smoking she’s incorrigible.

terms.meaning: (n.) an enlargement; the process of increasing
terms.translation: Sự tăng thêm; quá trình tăng lên.
terms.exampleSentence: The workmen made the wall longer, increment by increment.

terms.meaning: 1. (n.) one who holds an office; 2. (adj.) obligatory
terms.translation: 1. (danh từ) Người đương nhiệm; 2. (tính từ) Bắt buộc.
terms.exampleSentence: The incumbent senator is already serving his fifth term. It is incumbent upon this organization to offer aid to all who seek it.

terms.translation: Không biết mệt mỏi, không thể bị đánh bại, thất bại hay suy tàn.
terms.exampleSentence: Even after traveling 62 miles, the indefatigable runner kept on moving.

terms.translation: Bản địa, có nguồn gốc từ một vùng.
terms.exampleSentence: Some fear that these plants, which are not indigenous to the region, may choke out the vegetation that is native to the area.

terms.translation: rất nghèo khổ, túng thiếu
terms.exampleSentence: I would rather donate money to help the indigent population than to the park sculpture fund.

terms.meaning: (n.) anger sparked by something unjust or unfair
terms.translation: sự tức giận do điều bất công, không công bằng gây ra
terms.exampleSentence: I resigned from the sorority because of my indignation at its hazing of new members.

terms.translation: lười biếng, biếng nhác
terms.exampleSentence: Why should my indolent children, who can’t even pick themselves up off the couch to pour their own juice, be rewarded with a trip to the mall?

terms.translation: không thể bị khuất phục, bất khuất
terms.exampleSentence: To be honest, Jim, my indomitable nature means I could never take orders from anyone, and especially not from a jerk like you.

terms.translation: gây ra, xui khiến; kích thích
terms.exampleSentence: Who knew that our decision to boycott school lunch would induce a huge riot?

terms.meaning: (adj.) unspeakable, incapable of being expressed through words
terms.translation: không thể diễn tả bằng lời, không nói nên lời
terms.exampleSentence: It is said that the experience of playing with a dolphin is ineffable and can only be understood through direct encounter.

terms.translation: không phù hợp, không có khả năng; không đủ tư cách
terms.exampleSentence: She proved how inept she was when she forgot three orders and spilled a beer in a customer’s lap.

terms.meaning: (adj.) incapable of being persuaded or placated
terms.translation: không thể lay chuyển, không thể bị thuyết phục
terms.exampleSentence: Although I begged for hours, Mom was inexorable and refused to let me stay out all night after the prom.

terms.translation: không thể gỡ rối, vướng mắc không thể tách rời
terms.exampleSentence: Unless I look at the solution manual, I have no way of solving this inextricable problem.

terms.translation: sự tai tiếng, tiếng xấu cực độ
terms.exampleSentence: The infamy of his crime will not lessen as the decades pass.

terms.meaning: (n.) an injection of one substance into another; the permeation of one substance by another
terms.translation: sự tiêm truyền một chất vào chất khác; sự thấm nhuần
terms.exampleSentence: The infusion of Eastern religion into Western philosophy created interesting new schools of thought.

terms.translation: khéo léo, tài tình; tháo vát
terms.exampleSentence: Her ingenious use of walnuts instead of the peanuts called for by the recipe was lauded by the other garden club members who found her cake delicious.

terms.translation: không xảo quyệt; ngây thơ và thẳng thắn
terms.exampleSentence: He must have writers, but his speeches seem so ingenuous it’s hard to believe he’s not speaking from his own heart.

terms.translation: ngăn chặn, kiềm chế, cản trở
terms.exampleSentence: When I told you I needed the car last night, I certainly never meant to inhibit you from going out.

terms.translation: thù địch, có hại
terms.exampleSentence: I don’t see how I could ever work for a company that was so cold and inimical to me during my interviews.

terms.translation: sự độc ác, tội lỗi
terms.exampleSentence: “Your iniquity,” said the priest to the practical jokester, “will be forgiven.”

terms.translation: lệnh cấm, lệnh chính thức cảnh báo
terms.exampleSentence: After his house was toilet-papered for the fifth time, the mayor issued an injunction against anyone younger than 21 buying toilet paper.

terms.translation: bẩm sinh, vốn có, cố hữu
terms.exampleSentence: His incredible athletic talent is innate, he never trains, lifts weights, or practices.

terms.translation: vô hại, không gây khó chịu
terms.exampleSentence: In spite of their innocuous appearance, these mushrooms are actually quite poisonous.

terms.meaning: (v.) to do something in an unprecedented way
terms.translation: đổi mới, sáng tạo theo cách chưa từng có
terms.exampleSentence: Because of the stiff competition, the company knew it needed to pour a lot of energy into innovating new and better products.

terms.translation: lời ám chỉ, lời bóng gió
terms.exampleSentence: During the debate, the politician made several innuendos about the sexual activities of his opponent.

terms.meaning: (v.) to introduce a microorganism, serum, or vaccine into an organism in order to increase immunity to illness; to vaccinate
terms.translation: tiêm chủng, cấy vi sinh vật hoặc vắc-xin để tăng miễn dịch
terms.exampleSentence: I’ve feared needles ever since I was inoculated against 37 diseases at age one; but I have also never been sick.

terms.meaning: (n.) one who inquires, especially in a hostile manner
terms.translation: người điều tra, đặc biệt là một cách thù địch
terms.exampleSentence: The inquisitor was instructed to knock on every door in town in order to find the fugitive.

terms.translation: không thể thỏa mãn, vô độ
terms.exampleSentence: My insatiable appetite for melons can be a real problem in the winter.

terms.translation: hấp dẫn nhưng ngấm ngầm có hại, xảo quyệt
terms.exampleSentence: Lisa’s insidious chocolate cake tastes so good but makes you feel so sick later on!

terms.translation: ám chỉ, gợi ý một cách gián tiếp hoặc tinh tế
terms.exampleSentence: I wish Luke and Spencer would stop insinuating that my perfect report card is the result of anything other than my superior intelligence and good work habits.

terms.translation: nhạt nhẽo, vô vị, tẻ nhạt
terms.exampleSentence: The play was so insipid, I fell asleep halfway through.

terms.translation: thô lỗ, xấc xược, ngạo mạn
terms.exampleSentence: That celebrity is so insolent, making fun of his fans right to their faces.

terms.translation: xúi giục, kích động
terms.exampleSentence: The demagogue instigated the crowd into a fury by telling them that they had been cheated by the federal government.

terms.meaning: (adj.) separated and narrow-minded; tight-knit, closed off
terms.translation: cô lập và hẹp hòi; khép kín
terms.exampleSentence: Because of the sensitive nature of their jobs, those who work for the CIA must remain insular and generally only spend time with each other.

terms.translation: kẻ nổi dậy, quân nổi dậy
terms.exampleSentence: The insurgent snuck into and defaced a different classroom each night until the administration agreed to meet his demands.

terms.translation: cần thiết cho sự hoàn chỉnh, không thể thiếu
terms.exampleSentence: Without the integral ingredient of flour, you wouldn’t be able to make bread.

terms.translation: xen vào, chen vào giữa
terms.exampleSentence: During our conversation, the cab driver occasionally interjected his opinion.

terms.meaning: (n.) someone who participates in a dialogue or conversation
terms.translation: người tham gia đối thoại hoặc cuộc trò chuyện
terms.exampleSentence: When the officials could not come to an agreement over the correct cover of the flags, the prime minister acted as an interlocutor.

terms.translation: vô tận, không ngừng
terms.exampleSentence: The fact that biology lectures came just before lunch made them seem interminable.

terms.translation: sự ám chỉ, gợi ý gián tiếp
terms.exampleSentence: Mr. Brinford’s intimation that he would soon pass away occurred when he began to discuss how to distribute his belongings among his children.

terms.translation: khó kiểm soát, khó quản lý, cứng đầu
terms.exampleSentence: There was no end in sight to the intractable conflict between the warring countries.

terms.meaning: (adj.) refusing to compromise, often on an extreme opinion
terms.translation: không khoan nhượng, không thỏa hiệp
terms.exampleSentence: The intransigent child said he would have 12 scoops of ice cream, or he would bang his head against the wall until his mother fainted from fear.

terms.meaning: (adj.) brave in the face of danger
terms.translation: gan dạ, dũng cảm đối mặt với nguy hiểm
terms.exampleSentence: After scaling a live volcano prior to its eruption, the explorer was praised for his intrepid attitude.

terms.translation: làm ngập lụt, tràn ngập (với số lượng lớn)
terms.exampleSentence: Because I am the star of a new sitcom, my fans are sure to inundate me with fan mail and praise.

terms.meaning: (v.) to cause someone or something to become accustomed to a situation
terms.translation: Khiến ai đó hoặc cái gì đó quen với một tình huống.
terms.exampleSentence: Twenty years in the salt mines inured the man to the discomforts of dirt and grime.

terms.translation: Lời công kích bằng lời nói đầy giận dữ.
terms.exampleSentence: My mother’s irrational invective against the way I dress only made me decide to dye my hair green.

terms.translation: Ăn sâu, cố hữu do thói quen.
terms.exampleSentence: I’m the first to admit that I’m an inveterate coffee drinker—I drink four cups a day.

terms.translation: Bất khả xâm phạm, an toàn trước sự tấn công.
terms.exampleSentence: Nobody was ever able to break into Batman’s inviolable Batcave.

terms.translation: Dễ nổi nóng, cáu kỉnh.
terms.exampleSentence: At the smallest provocation, my irascible cat will begin scratching and clawing.

terms.translation: Óng ánh như cầu vồng, có màu sắc rực rỡ.
terms.exampleSentence: The bride’s large diamond ring was iridescent in the afternoon sun.

terms.translation: Sự thiếu tôn trọng, bất kính.
terms.exampleSentence: The irreverence displayed by the band that marched through the chapel disturbed many churchgoers.

terms.translation: Không thể thay đổi, không thể rút lại.
terms.exampleSentence: The Bill of Rights is an irrevocable part of American law.

terms.translation: Vui sướng tột độ, hân hoan.
terms.exampleSentence: The crowd was jubilant when the firefighter carried the woman from the flaming building.

terms.translation: Sáng suốt, có óc phán đoán đúng đắn.
terms.exampleSentence: When the judicious king decided to compromise rather than send his army to its certain death, he was applauded.

terms.meaning: (n.) the act of placing two things next to each other for implicit comparison
terms.translation: Hành động đặt hai thứ cạnh nhau để so sánh ngầm.
terms.exampleSentence: The interior designer admired my juxtaposition of the yellow couch and green table.

terms.meaning: (n.) the solemn sound of a bell, often indicating a death
terms.translation: Tiếng chuông tang lễ trang trọng, thường báo hiệu cái chết.
terms.exampleSentence: Echoing throughout our village, the funeral knell made the stormy day even more grim.

terms.translation: Lời khen ngợi cho một thành tựu.
terms.exampleSentence: After the performance, the reviewers gave the opera singer kudos for a job well done.

terms.translation: Vết cắt, vết rách.
terms.exampleSentence: Because he fell off his bike into a rosebush, the paperboy’s skin was covered with lacerations.

terms.translation: Súc tích, ngắn gọn trong lời nói hoặc văn viết.
terms.exampleSentence: The author’s laconic style has won him many followers who dislike wordiness.

terms.translation: Uể oải, chậm chạp do mệt mỏi hoặc yếu ớt.
terms.exampleSentence: In the summer months, the great heat makes people languid and lazy.

terms.meaning: (n.) obtaining another’s property by theft or trickery
terms.translation: Hành vi trộm cắp hoặc lừa đảo để chiếm đoạt tài sản của người khác.
terms.exampleSentence: When my car was not where I had left it, I realized that I was a victim of larceny.

terms.meaning: (n.) the generous giving of lavish gifts
terms.translation: Sự hào phóng trong việc tặng quà xa hoa.
terms.exampleSentence: My boss demonstrated great largess by giving me a new car.

terms.meaning: (adj.) hidden, but capable of being exposed
terms.translation: Tiềm ẩn, ẩn giấu nhưng có khả năng bộc lộ.
terms.exampleSentence: Sigmund’s dream represented his latent paranoid obsession with other people’s shoes.

terms.translation: Biểu lộ sự ngưỡng mộ hoặc khen ngợi.
terms.exampleSentence: Such laudatory comments are unusual from someone who is usually so reserved in his opinions.

terms.meaning: 1. (adj.) given without limits; 2. (v.) to give without limits
terms.translation: 1. (tính từ) Được ban tặng không giới hạn; 2. (động từ) Ban tặng không giới hạn.
terms.exampleSentence: Because they had worked very hard, the performers appreciated the critic’s lavish praise. Because the performers had worked hard, they deserved the praise that the critic lavished on them.

terms.translation: Sự lừa dối, trò ảo thuật.
terms.exampleSentence: Smuggling the French plants through customs by claiming that they were fake was a remarkable bit of legerdemain.

terms.translation: Khoan dung, nhân hậu, thể hiện sự nhẹ nhàng.
terms.exampleSentence: Because Professor Oglethorpe allowed his students to choose their final grades, the other teachers believed that he was excessively lenient.

terms.meaning: (adj.) in a state of sluggishness or apathy
terms.translation: Trong trạng thái lờ đờ, thờ ơ hoặc uể oải.
terms.exampleSentence: When Jean Claude explained to his boss that he was lethargic and didn’t feel like working that day, the boss fired him.

terms.meaning: 1. (n.) something for which one is legally responsible, usually involving a disadvantage or risk; 2. (n.) a handicap, burden
terms.translation: 1. (danh từ) Trách nhiệm pháp lý, thường liên quan đến bất lợi hoặc rủi ro; 2. (danh từ) Gánh nặng, trở ngại.
terms.exampleSentence: The bungee-jumping tower was a great liability for the owners of the carnival. Because she often lost her concentration and didn’t play defense, Marcy was a liability to the team.

terms.meaning: (adj.) advocating principles of liberty and free will
terms.translation: Ủng hộ các nguyên tắc tự do và ý chí tự do.
terms.exampleSentence: The dissatisfied subjects overthrew the monarch and replaced him with a libertarian ruler who respected their democratic principles.

terms.meaning: (adj.) displaying a lack of moral or legal restraints
terms.translation: Thiếu đạo đức hoặc không tuân thủ pháp luật.
terms.exampleSentence: Marilee has always been fascinated by the licentious private lives of politicians.

terms.translation: Trong suốt, rõ ràng.
terms.exampleSentence: Mr. Johnson’s limpid writing style greatly pleased readers who disliked complicated novels.

terms.meaning: (n.) something that holds separate parts together
terms.translation: Yếu tố then chốt, thứ giữ các phần riêng biệt lại với nhau.
terms.exampleSentence: The linchpin in the prosecution’s case was the hair from the defendant’s head, which was found at the scene of the crime.

terms.translation: Duyên dáng, mềm dẻo, uyển chuyển.
terms.exampleSentence: Although the dancers were all outstanding, Jae Sun’s control of her lithe body was particularly impressive.

terms.translation: Người tham gia vào một vụ kiện.
terms.exampleSentence: When the litigants began screaming at each other, Judge Koch ordered them to be silent.

terms.translation: Rõ ràng, dễ hiểu.
terms.exampleSentence: Because Guenevere’s essay was so lucid, I only had to read it once to understand her reasoning.

terms.translation: Sáng chói, phát sáng.
terms.exampleSentence: The light of the luminous moon graced the shoulders of the beautiful maiden.

terms.translation: Ghê rợn, giật gân.
terms.exampleSentence: Gideon’s story, in which he described a character torturing his sister’s dolls, was judged too lurid to be printed in the school’s literary magazine.

terms.meaning: (n.) a destructive whirlpool which rapidly sucks in objects
terms.translation: Xoáy nước hủy diệt hút nhanh các vật thể.
terms.exampleSentence: Little did the explorers know that as they turned the next bend of the calm river a vicious maelstrom would catch their boat.

terms.translation: Cao thượng, hào phóng.
terms.exampleSentence: Although I had already broken most of her dishes, Jacqueline was magnanimous enough to continue letting me use them.

terms.translation: Lời nguyền rủa.
terms.exampleSentence: When I was arrested for speeding, I screamed maledictions against the policeman and the entire police department.

terms.translation: Muốn điều xấu xảy ra với người khác, độc ác.
terms.exampleSentence: The malevolent old man sat in the park all day, tripping unsuspecting passersby with his cane.

terms.meaning: (adj.) capable of being shaped or transformed
terms.translation: Dễ uốn nắn, có thể định hình hoặc biến đổi.

terms.translation: Lệnh, chỉ thị có thẩm quyền.

terms.translation: (danh từ) người độc lập, không tuân theo quy tắc chung

terms.translation: (tính từ) ủy mị, sướt mướt một cách khó chịu

terms.translation: (tính từ) dối trá, không trung thực

terms.meaning: (adj.) characterized by rapid change or temperamentality

terms.translation: (động từ) xoa dịu, làm nguôi giận

terms.translation: bướng bỉnh, cứng đầu

terms.translation: ồn ào, ngỗ ngược

terms.translation: đáng ghét, gây căm ghét

terms.translation: đáng ngại, báo điềm xấu

terms.translation: phô trương, khoe khoang
